s.how: Mash 100g butter with crushed garlic, chopped parsley and grated parmesan. Split a loaf of Italian bread, spread thickly and bake at 200C for 12 minutes until crisp at the edges. Cut into thick slices and serve in the alley behind the restaurant.

s.note: the candlelit table set for Lady and Tramp
s.how: Fold 150g salami and slices of provolone onto a board. Add kalamata olives, marinated artichoke hearts and strips of roasted red capsicum. Tear a loaf of Italian bread beside it. Set it out for two by candlelight.

m.note: the famous spaghetti dinner behind Tony's
m.how: Mix 300g beef mince and 300g pork mince with parmesan, parsley and an egg, roll into balls and brown. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and torn basil and simmer 40 minutes. Pile over 500g spaghetti on one big plate. Leave the last meatball for your date.

w.how: Drain 500g ricotta overnight, then beat with 80g icing sugar, orange zest and 50g dark chocolate chips. Spoon into a piping bag and fill 12 cannoli shells just before serving. Dip each end in crushed pistachios.

d.how: Fill glasses with ice and a sprig of rosemary. Pour in blood orange juice and top with sparkling water. For the grown-ups, pour a glass of red wine instead. Serve at a small table with a checked cloth.
